verdict.rationale: ObsessionDB documents an MCP integration for coding agents with OAuth 2.1 auth (no API keys) and tools to list services and run SQL. It also exposes the native ClickHouse protocol and HTTP interface, so any CLI or driver can query and read results with no dashboard involved. Governance comes from roles scoped to table and column, full query logging of agent queries, and isolated read-only agent compute, while CHKit offers agent-drivable commands to describe schema. Missing for 10: an explicit MCP schema-discovery tool (only listing services and running SQL are documented), confirmation that table/column roles apply to the agent's OAuth path, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
